name: Mana Color Choice
displayDescription:
When starting a new character, you can choose their mana color using sliders.

Also, the Therapist NPC has a new option to let you choose your mana color with existing characters.

name: Name Choice
displayDescription: When starting a new character, you can choose their name from a list.

name: Private Dueling Servers
displayDescription:
Gives you the ability to create Private Servers for dueling!

NOTE: Data does not save in private servers.

name: Disrespect Emote Pack
displayDescription:
Includes the following emotes:
- What Is It?
- Point Down
- Clap

When in game, hold M to open your Emote Wheel, select 'Edit', click an emote and navigate to the "Gamepass" section to assign new emotes to your Emote Wheel! 

Lets you use all your favorite disrespect emotes.
May require rejoining or menuing/unmenuing for the gamepass to take effect.

name: Voice Stones
displayDescription:
Includes the following emotes:
- Thank You!
- I'm Sorry!
- Very Good!

When in game, hold M to open your Emote Wheel, select 'Edit', click an emote and navigate to the "Gamepass" section to assign new emotes to your Emote Wheel! 

Lets you throw strange stones that produce voices.
May require rejoining or menuing/unmenuing for the gamepass to take effect.

name: Respect Emote Pack
displayDescription:
Includes the following emotes:
- Kneel
- Salute
- Cry

When in game, hold M to open your Emote Wheel, select 'Edit', click an emote and navigate to the "Gamepass" section to assign new emotes to your Emote Wheel! 

Lets you use emotes to show respect (or not). 
May require rejoining or menuing/unmenuing for the gamepass to take effect.
